csv_project_name: Project Development For US 30 Intersection Improvement
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide Project Development Services Two Intersection Improvement projects on US 30 at .5 miles west of Austin Ave to Cline Ave and .5 miles west of SR 55 to .5 east of SR 55 in Lake County. The selected firm will perform the design and plan development work necessary to produce the construction contract documents. The selected firm will be required to provide all required Environmental Documentation, all Permits, Public Involvement-including public hearing and public information meetings, Topographic Survey, Road Design, Utility Coordination, Hydraulic Analysis and Design, Right of Way Plan Development (including Abstracting, R/W Engineering and R/W Staking), pavement design, traffic management plan, and Construction Phase Services. Additional services may also be required, such as, Wetland Mitigation, Archaeological Investigations, Historical/Architectural Investigations, and Subsurface Utility Engineering. INDOT will perform the geotechnical services, RW Buying and Real Estate Closing activities. The selected consultant's fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the selection date for this RFP item. Contract may utilize eInvoice.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Biological Studies/Natural Resources, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Archaeology, Utility Engineering, Habitat Restoration/Wetlands Restoration

- Limited fit with sbp's core focus on bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, and innovative structural design.
